prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a bustling hospital corridor scene. On the left, a nurse in blue scrubs stands holding a clipboard next to a gurney with silver rails. In the center, a doctor in a white coat walks forward, carrying a stethoscope around their neck. The doctor is looking at a tablet held in their left hand. Next to the doctor, a young boy in a striped shirt runs past, clutching a teddy bear. The boy is smiling broadly as he moves. To the right, an elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a plastic chair, resting her hands on her lap. A golden retriever lies on the floor next to her, sleeping peacefully. The woman is looking down at the dog with a gentle expression. Behind them, a janitor in gray overalls pushes a yellow mop bucket along the wall. The janitor is wiping the floor with a long-handled mop. Near the ceiling on the right, a security camera hangs from a bracket, observing the hall. Above the center, fluorescent lights illuminate the space evenly. A fire extinguisher is mounted on the wall near the left corner. A vending machine stands against the far back wall, stocked with colorful drinks. A man in a suit leans against the vending machine, checking his watch. He is tapping his foot impatiently. A receptionist behind a glass partition looks up from a computer screen. The receptionist is typing on a keyboard. A child’s balloon floats near the ceiling in the center, tied to a string. The string is held by the running boy. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no signage with readable text on the walls. There is no outdoor window showing the sky.
